title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
slides: Character.AI files for bankruptcy after just 5 years.
It once hit 28 million monthly users, valued at billions.
But most users were teens and paying almost nothing.
If you build on Character.AI, your bots may die too.
Diversify your AI stack before it favors you.
thread_text:
1. 28 Million Users, Zero Dollars

Character.AI filed for bankruptcy after five years, despite hitting 28 million monthly users and a multi-billion valuation. Paying customers were almost nonexistent.

2. The Teenager Trap

Most of those millions were teens who couldn't or wouldn't pay. A massive user base means nothing if the revenue per user rounds to zero.

3. Your Bots Are Hostages

If you built on Character.AI, your characters die with the platform. No migration path, no warning—just gone.

4. The Stack Is Fragile

Every AI tool you rely on is one bankruptcy away from disappearing. The companies look stable until they don't.

5. Audit Your AI Dependencies Today

List every AI platform you use, then ask: what happens if it shuts down tomorrow? If you don't have a backup, start there.
